frameworks.name: Community Mod Framework (CMF)
frameworks.reason: Last Workshop update 2026-10-03, before 1.4 went live on 2026-10-28. It already carries the 1.4 version tag, but that build predates the release (open-beta era), so it isn't confirmed for the live 1.4. 1.4 is under a week old: wait for a post-release update. No open breakage reports on its GitHub tracker since 1.4 went live. Workshop comments since 1.4 went live report CMF breaking some interface graphics on 1.4.5 and the country-selection bonus icons (a UI function it calls was removed in 1.4).
